en: Sepia portrait postcard of an older military officer in a German-style uniform with large moustache, wearing an Iron Cross at the neck and other high decorations on his chest. The background is plain. At the bottom of the image there is a facsimile handwritten inscription in German, ending with a signature and rank title. The card is bordered and shown against a measurement grid.
